title: SPARE: Fast Linear Attention Decoding with Compact Recurrent States
abstract: arXiv:2611.07552v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Linear attention reduces the quadratic sequence-length complexity of softmax attention by maintaining fixed-size recurrent states. However, these states scale quadratically with the representation dimension and require repeated data transfers during decoding, creating a substantial GPU memory bottleneck. Recent studies have revealed significant low-rank redundancy in recurrent states, suggesting opportunities for more efficient representations. We introduce SPARE (State Projection for Accelerated Recurrent Execution), a training-free method that exploits this redundancy through fixed low-dimensional subspaces, heterogeneous rank allocation, and lightweight write compensation. By performing recurrent reads and updates directly on compact states, SPARE reduces memory traffic without online decomposition or dense-state reconstruction. SPARE achieves 2.55x full-model decoding speedup, 7.49x lower recurrent-kernel DRAM traffic, and 3.31x lowe

translated_title: SPARE：基于紧凑循环状态的快速线性注意力解码
translated_abstract: 线性注意力通过维护固定大小的循环状态，降低了softmax注意力的二次序列长度复杂度。然而，这些状态的大小随表示维度呈二次增长，并且在解码过程中需要反复的数据传输，造成了显著的GPU内存瓶颈。近期研究揭示了循环状态中存在显著的低秩冗余，这为更高效的表示提供了机会。我们提出SPARE（State Projection for Accelerated Recurrent Execution，用于加速循环执行的状态投影），这是一种无需训练的方法，通过固定低维子空间、异构秩分配和轻量级写入补偿来利用这种冗余。通过直接在紧凑状态上执行循环读取和更新，SPARE减少了内存流量，而无需在线分解或密集状态重建。SPARE实现了2.55倍的全模型解码加速，循环内核DRAM流量降低7.49倍，以及3.31倍较低的……
tldr: SPARE是一种无需训练的方法，通过固定低维子空间、异构秩分配和轻量级写入补偿来压缩线性注意力的循环状态，直接在紧凑状态上进行循环读取与更新，从而实现2.55倍全模型解码加速和7.49倍的DRAM流量降低。
en_tdlr: SPARE is a training-free method that compresses linear attention recurrent states via fixed low-dimensional subspaces, heterogeneous rank allocation, and lightweight write compensation, enabling recurrent reads and updates directly on compact states to achieve 2.55x full-model decoding speedup and 7.49x lower DRAM traffic.
